additional_info.subject: ID0471735-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/S4170003550] Charging Performance Issue CRM:03288000109
additional_info.body:
Dear Gregoire,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support.
Following a review of the provided information, we can confirm that the issue is not due to the charging station. Is related to the simultaneous connection of the three vehicles you mentioned.
The station delivered exactly the power requested by each car based on the session start time. When multiple cars charge simultaneously, power is shared but not equally (depending on the configuration of the charger).
Best regards,
Ivan
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team

additional_info.subject: ID0471735-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/S4170003550] Charging Performance Issue CRM:03288000109
additional_info.body:
Dear Gregoire,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support.
Regarding your request, there are no error logs to share as the system recorded no faults during the session.
Please note that charging profiles vary significantly by vehicle brand. Some vehicles start at a lower power level and increase gradually, while others follow the opposite pattern. Additionally, power allocation follows a
'first-come, first-served
' logic. This combination explains the behavior observed in your case.
Best regards,
Ivan
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team

additional_info.subject: ID0471735-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/S4170003550] Charging Performance Issue CRM:03277000064
additional_info.body:
Dear
Gregoire DESMOUTIER
I would like to inform you that your support case
0471735
has been resolved.
Here is a summary of the actions taken:
The issue was not caused by the charging station. It was related to three vehicles connecting simultaneously. The station delivered the specific power requested by each vehicle based on its session start time. When multiple vehicles charge at once, power is shared - though not always equally - depending on the configuration of the charger.
Since the reported issue has been resolved, I will proceed to close this case.
Thank you for your cooperation, and please don’t hesitate to reach out through our support form for any future requests:
www.siemens.com/emobility-service-request
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Ivan Perotto
